lines.text: Solomon began building the house of the LORD on Mount Sinai, on David's prepared threshing floor, in his fourth year.
Solomon made the Most Holy Place, overlaid it with six hundred talents of fine gold, and set two cherubim inside.
Solomon set up two pillars in front of the temple and named the southern one Jachin and the northern one Boaz.
Solomon made the Sea of cast metal, which stood on twelve lions, three facing each direction.
Solomon made the golden altar and the tables for the Bread of the Presence, along with lampstands of pure gold.
